title: The sky tables now reach into 2027
summary: The equinox and alignment tables used to stop at the end of 2026 — from March 2027 the site would quietly have gone on showing last year's sky. The March 2027 equinox (March 20, 20:24:41 UTC) is now recorded from the U.S. Naval Observatory's Earth's Seasons, its whole second computed and checked against a second ephemeris, and the Equinox Passage and the Alignment Ledger both run 2014–2027.
